purpose: Short-lived server-authoritative WebAuthn ceremony state for registration, anonymous authentication and session reauthentication with exact RP/origin and Account/session/userHandle binding.

columns.name: webauthn_challenge_ref
columns.meaning: Stable row ref for one WebAuthn ceremony.

columns.name: challenge_verifier
columns.meaning: Verifier for the raw WebAuthn challenge capability.
columns.value_contract: Exactly 32 bytes; raw challenge never persists.

columns.name: auth_session_secret_verifier
columns.meaning: Begin-time snapshot of the exact session bearer verifier.
columns.value_contract: Exactly 32 bytes when bound; never raw session secret.

columns.name: user_handle
columns.meaning: Exact opaque WebAuthn user handle expected for bound Account ceremonies.
columns.value_contract: Exactly 32 bytes for registration/reauthentication; null for anonymous authentication.

columns.name: rp_id
columns.meaning: Exact relying-party ID frozen for verification.

columns.name: expected_origin
columns.meaning: Exact browser origin frozen for verification.
columns.value_contract: Trimmed non-empty <=2048; application validates URL/origin semantics.

columns.name: claimed_at
columns.meaning: Single-use claim instant before accepting a ceremony response.
columns.value_contract: Null until claimed; finite within ceremony lifetime.

foreign_keys.name: fk_webauthn_challenge_session_account
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: For authenticated ceremonies, require the exact AuthSession to belong to the exact Account frozen into the ceremony.

foreign_keys.name: fk_webauthn_challenge_account_user_handle
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: For authenticated ceremonies, require the opaque userHandle to belong to the same exact Account.

unique_constraints.name: uq_webauthn_challenge_challenge_verifier
unique_constraints.reason: Prevent challenge verifier reuse across live/retained ceremony rows.

check_constraints.name: ck_webauthn_challenge_session_binding
check_constraints.expression_contract: anonymous authentication has no Account/session/userHandle; registration and reauthentication require all bound refs/verifiers and 32-byte values
check_constraints.reason: Make anonymous and authenticated ceremony security boundaries mutually explicit.

check_constraints.name: ck_webauthn_challenge_claimed_at
check_constraints.expression_contract: claimed_at null or finite within ceremony lifetime
check_constraints.reason: Make single-use ceremony claim chronology valid.

indexes.name: ix_webauthn_challenge_account_ref
indexes.reason: Account-bound ceremony lookup and composite FK support.

indexes.name: ix_webauthn_challenge_auth_session_ref
indexes.reason: Session-bound ceremony lookup and composite FK support.

state_history.current_binding: One row is one exact WebAuthn ceremony with RP/origin and optional Account/session/userHandle binding frozen at begin.
state_history.chronology: created -> optional claimed -> terminal consume/expiry -> delete.
state_history.immutability_policy: Ceremony identity, challenge verifier, RP/origin and binding evidence are immutable; only claimed_at mutates.

lifecycle.retention: Ephemeral control state deleted after terminal completion or bounded expiry cleanup.
lifecycle.redaction: Challenge verifier, session-binding snapshot and user handle are security-sensitive.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: Runtime DELETE is permitted only for terminal consumption/cleanup.

obligations: M5 real PostgreSQL RP/origin, exact Account/session/userHandle binding, bounded expiry, single-use claim and exact ACL proof
